description: Form field group layout with reactive validation feedback states, helper copy, and loading FSM submit actions.

fragments.emmet: div.flex.flex-col.gap-4[data-slot=fields]>(div.flex.flex-col.gap-2[data-slot=field-name]>label.text-xs.font-medium[for=name]{Full Name}+input.input.input-sm#name[type=text][placeholder='Jane Doe'][required][data-state=valid]+p.text-xs.text-muted-foreground{Displayed on your public profile.})+(div.flex.flex-col.gap-2[data-slot=field-email]>label.text-xs.font-medium[for=email]{Email Address}+input.input.input-sm#email[type=email][placeholder='jane@example.com'][required][data-state=valid]+p.text-xs.text-destructive[data-state=invalid]{Please enter a valid email address.})+(div.flex.flex-col.gap-2[data-slot=field-bio]>label.text-xs.font-medium[for=bio]{Bio}+textarea.textarea.textarea-sm#bio[placeholder='Brief description...'][rows=3]+p.text-xs.text-muted-foreground{Max 250 characters.})
